content_sections.heading: About OHPC
content_sections.text: Odisha Hydro Power Corporation Ltd. was incorporated in 1995 as a hydro power generation company of Odisha and functions under the state's Energy Department. Its installed capacity has grown from 1273.53 MW to 2099.8 MW, with 6 projects within the state and one interstate project in operation. This Gold rated State PSU also promotes renewable energy investment through its wholly owned subsidiary GEDCOL and is taking up new hydro projects, including Pumped Storage Projects and Small Hydro Projects.

content_sections.heading: OHPC Managing Director Vacancy Details 2026
content_sections.text: The pay follows a Cost to Company pattern. Over and above the CTC, the post carries an official vehicle, Company accommodation or HRA, Medical Facilities, and other allowances and perks as per the rules of the Corporation. Pay protection will be allowed only to Officers from the Central or State Governments, CPSEs, State PSUs or any other Government Organization. The Managing Director is the Chief Executive of the Company and is accountable to the Chairman, Board of Directors, Government of Odisha. Smooth operation and maintenance, renovation and modernisation of hydro power plants. Interaction with the authorities of GoI, Govt. of Odisha and stakeholders. Planning and execution of new hydro projects and Pumped Storage Projects. Efficient functioning of the Corporation for achieving its vision and objectives, and driving it to a new trajectory of growth with dynamic leadership. content_sections.heading: OHPC Managing Director Eligibility 2026
content_sections.text: Mandatory: The applicant should be an engineering graduate with good academic record from a recognised University or Institute. Preferred: Engineering preferably in Civil, Mechanical or Electrical. An applicant holding MBA or PGDM will have an added advantage. Every applicant needs a proven track record of at least 20 years of post-qualification experience in relevant functional areas. The senior-level requirement depends on the applicant's background: Both groups must furnish an organisational chart showing their current position. Experience in execution of large Hydroelectric projects. Experience in operation and maintenance of large hydro power plants. Well conversant with the power sector, including its policies and recent developments. Well conversant with Project Management and execution of a Hydro Power Project or Pumped Storage Project. On the date of application, the applicant must be employed in a regular capacity in one of the following: Central Public Sector Enterprise (CPSE) State Public Sector Enterprise Central or State Govt. Private Sector Enterprises having turnover of more than Rs.500 Crores in any of the last three years (FY 2022-23, FY 2023-24 and FY 2024-25) See the official notification for the discipline-specific eligibility of this post.

rows.senior_level_requirement: At least 3 years in a senior level position drawing pay in the scale of Rs.1,23,100-2,15,900/- (level-15 of the pay matrix under the ORSP Rules, 2017) or a higher scale on the date of application

At least 5 years in a senior level position in an organisation of repute, OR drawing pay in the scale of Rs.1,23,100-2,15,900/- (level-15, ORSP Rules, 2017), its equivalent revised scale or a higher scale of Central Govt., State Govt., CPSE, SPSE or other organisation on the date of application

content_sections.heading: Service Conditions
content_sections.text: Nature and tenure: Full time contract for 5 years or up to the age of 65 years, whichever is earlier, subject to the terms and conditions of appointment. Probation: 1 year, included in the tenure. Appointment shall be confirmed after satisfactory completion of probation and approval of the Energy Department. Extension: May be allowed in exceptional cases, to candidates with residual service, up to 65 years, subject to performance assessment by PESB or the Energy Department. There will not be any extension beyond two terms and 65 years of age. Deputation: Interested candidates from Government, CPSUs, SPSUs, or State or Central Govt. may be considered on deputation for a period of not less than 3 years. Lien: Eligible selected candidates, other than internal candidates, serving in Government, CPSUs, SPSUs or other Government organisations may retain a lien in their parent organisation, subject to its rules. They must furnish a valid Lien Certificate from the competent authority at the time of joining, and may join back on completion or cessation of the tenure, subject to the lien terms and the parent organisation's rules. Minimum service with lien: 3 years, unless the appointment is terminated earlier in accordance with its terms and conditions. Internal candidates: If selected, the candidate should resign or take Voluntary Retirement and join as Managing Director on contractual appointment.

faq.question: Q1. Can private sector executives apply for the OHPC Managing Director post?
faq.answer: Yes, if they are employed in a regular capacity in a Private Sector Enterprise with turnover of more than Rs.500 Crores in any of the last three years, and meet the other conditions. They forward the application through their Controlling Officer.

faq.question: Q2. Is an MBA compulsory?
faq.answer: No. The requirement is an engineering degree, and an MBA or PGDM is only an added advantage.

faq.question: Q3. How long is the appointment?
faq.answer: It runs for 5 years or up to the age of 65 years, whichever is earlier, and includes 1 year of probation.

faq.question: Q4. Can a government officer join on deputation?
faq.answer: Candidates from Government, CPSUs and SPSUs may be considered on deputation, but the deputation period shall not be less than 3 years.

faq.question: Q5. Is it enough to post the application by the last date?
faq.answer: No. The application must reach the Energy Department in Bhubaneswar by 15 December 2026, and late applications shall not be considered.

faq.question: Q6. Does OHPC pay for travel to the interview?
faq.answer: Outstation candidates appearing for the interview will be provided economy class air fare for the to and fro journey on submission of original documents.

faq.question: Q7. What happens if a selected candidate declines the post?
faq.answer: A candidate who gives unwillingness after the interview or after the offer of appointment shall be debarred for two years from being considered for a Board Level post in any State PSU. No request for relaxation would be entertained.

faq.question: Q8. Which pay level counts for the senior-level experience?
faq.answer: The notice uses the scale of Rs.1,23,100-2,15,900/-, level-15 of the pay matrix under the ORSP Rules, 2017, as the benchmark. Internal candidates need 3 years at this level or higher, while other candidates may qualify through 5 years in a senior level position or by drawing this scale, its equivalent or higher.
